messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: [P1] inference-queue-backlog triggered for service=inference-frontend - 8m avg queue depth > 12000 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: page fired -> Escalation level 1. Triggered by metric: queue.depth > 10k for 5m. Incident link: https://pd.example/INC12345
oncall-ryan: acked. i'm on it. looking at infra/metrics now.
sre_maya: seeing steady increase in queue depth and avg latency. autoscaler view shows 'scale_request_pending' for the last 4m. CPU on nodes looks normal.
eng-aaron: adding notes — last deploy ~2h ago touched dispatcher config? but rollouts were canaryed. no alerts then.
ops-kim: checking cloud provider throttles — seeing elevated 429s on compute API in us-west-2 during the last 6m. could explain scaling delays.
oncall-ryan: okay, mitigation plan: 1) force manual spin-up of 4 warm nodes in shared-pool 2) bypass autoscaler for this cell 3) enable prefix-kv-cache eviction to free memory. doing step 1 now.
platform-lead: +1 to manual spin. remember to annotate why in the autoscale controller runbook.
oncall-ryan: running command: ```./infractl instances create --pool shared-pool --count 4 --type g5.xlarge --tag incident=INC12345```
sre_maya: cloud API errors continuing. some node creates are pending with provider showing rate limit. we might need to pick a different instance type or region to get capacity fast.
eng-aaron: trying cross-zone fallback: launching 2 nodes in us-west-1 as a temporary patch. command: ```./infractl instances create --pool shared-pool --count 2 --type g5.xlarge --region us-west-1 --tag incident=INC12345```
oncall-ryan: added annotation to the runbook: "manual spin-up due to provider API throttling" :memo:
ops-kim: provider support responded — they saw a control-plane throttle. estimated clear in ~12m. suggested using smaller instance sku to bypass quota.
oncall-ryan: spun up 2 smaller nodes g4dn.xlarge as a stopgap. nodes joined the cluster, kube-scheduler distributed pods, starting to see backlog drain slowly.
sre_maya: metrics: queue depth dropping from 12.3k -> 7.9k over last 6m after nodes joined. latency p50 improving. still seeing a few 503s from workers while caches warm.
oncall-ryan: opened a temporary routing rule to spill new requests to dedicated-warm pool to relieve hotcell: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: temp-routing-INC12345
data:
  route: "route-prefix=/v1/generate -> pool=dedicated-warm"
EOF```
eng-aaron: thanks — that reduced hotpath pressure. inform customer success to advise impacted customers of short degradation.
customer_success_jess: pinged top 3 affected accounts via email w/ initial heads-up. will update once we have full RCA.
oncall-ryan: ack. continuing to monitor for 20m. if queue depth < 2k and p99 latency stable, we'll demote manual nodes and re-enable autoscaler.
sre_maya: note for postmortem: autoscaler queue backlog metric didn't trigger a graceful fallback to model-variant degrade. suggest adding fallback policy to route to lower-memory model variant when scale_request_pending > 3m.
platform-lead: also add a test in chaos/infra tests to simulate provider API 429s and verify manual spin-up path works.
ops-kim: provider cleared control-plane throttles. new node API requests succeeding again.
oncall-ryan: beginning scale-down: draining incident nodes gracefully. command: ```kubectl cordon node-abc123 && kubectl drain node-abc123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
sre_maya: queue depth now 1.1k, p99 stable at pre-incident baseline. marking incident as contained.
oncall-ryan: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged, status -> contained. adding final notes to thread.
pagerduty: note added: 'manual spin-up + routing bypass used to mitigate while provider throttling cleared'
eng-aaron: +1 on timeline capture. follow-ups: 1) runbook update, 2) autoscaler fallback policy, 3) chaos test for provider throttles, 4) cost analysis for emergency multi-region spin-up.
customer_success_jess: follow-up: outreach scheduled for impacted accounts, will include ETA and SLA credit proposal if needed.
platform-lead: assigning action items: @sre_maya runbook update; @eng-aaron autoscaler fallback policy; @ops-kim chaos test + provider quota liaison. please add to next sprint.
oncall-ryan: closing thread in 10m after clean verification. thanks everyone for fast response :clap:
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 transition -> contained. Postmortem task created: https://pm.example/INC12345-postmortem
